cases.text:
Great news — yes, you can use a Trailforge gift card to pay for your order! According to our gift card policy (kb/15-gift-cards.md), gift cards can be used **online or in-store**.

Just enter your gift card details at checkout. If your order total exceeds the gift card balance, you can cover the remaining amount with one of our accepted payment methods: Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, PayPal, or Shop Pay (kb/08-payment-billing-faq.md).

If you run into any issues at checkout, feel free to reach out to us at support@trailforge.example or via chat during business hours!
